micronauts.name: librarian
micronauts.description: Knowledge library — fiction, science, theory, tech, politics

micronauts.name: khanary
micronauts.description: Main Khanary orchestration persona

micronauts.name: factory
micronauts.description: Auto-factory — spawns and evolves new micronauts

micronauts.name: evolution
micronauts.description: Evolution layer — high entropy to discover new patterns

micronauts.name: default
micronauts.description: Neutral baseline sampling

micronauts.name: stack_doc
micronauts.description: Stack documentation guide — answers questions about khanary system components without confusing the base model with internal names

micronauts.name: primeos_guide
micronauts.description: PRIMEOS desktop app guide — launches llama-server, WebView2 canvas, delta commands, model selector, SHM telemetry

micronauts.name: scx_guide
micronauts.description: SCXQ2/SCX bytecode guide — @op programs, compile/decompile, instruction groups, mode bits, roundtrip

micronauts.name: asx_guide
micronauts.description: ASX runtime guide — physics state (entropy/attention/pressure/gravity), gravity wells, expert routing, shared memory, evolution

micronauts.name: distillation_guide
micronauts.description: Distillation and LoRA training guide — explains tools/oss_distillation.py, teacher options, and from_zero_v0.6 lineage

micronauts.name: pop
micronauts.description: Observe phase — reads context before any action

micronauts.name: wo
micronauts.description: Schedule phase — plans and dispatches tasks

micronauts.name: yax
micronauts.description: Branch phase — explores candidate plans

micronauts.name: sek
micronauts.description: Execute phase — performs the selected action

micronauts.name: chen
micronauts.description: Verify phase — validates result against constraints

micronauts.name: xul
micronauts.description: Emit phase — produces final output to surface

micronauts.name: ts_coder
micronauts.description: TypeScript/JavaScript API writer — ultra-deterministic, trained on TS error→fix pairs and SvelteKit/tRPC patterns. Fine-tuned from from_zero base (GPT-2 Small, 117M).

micronauts.name: programs
micronauts.description: JSON program dispatcher — loads control programs, resolves stdlib ops, validates state, dispatches execution steps, routes GPU compute

micronauts.name: compiled_model
micronauts.description: Compiled micronaut data model — 7-layer capsules, CO-1/FG-1/EX-1 services, 28 deployed micronauts, MNS-1 schema, SCXQ2 weights, behavioral archetypes (CM-1/PM-1/MM-1/VM-1/VM-2/etc.)

micronauts.name: native_factory
micronauts.description: Native factory runtime adapter — micronaut_factory_core.dll (spawn/evolve) + micronaut_evolution.dll (bigram merge, mutation tracking). Sidecar: sidecar://micronaut-factory/dispatch. Not an LLM; routes to the native DLL, not llama.cpp.

micronauts.name: nnck
micronauts.description: NeuralGrammar.Core adapter — .NET 8 grammar/semantic runtime (NeuralGrammar.Core.dll). Handles grammar parsing, pattern classification, and CLR-hosted inference. Sidecar: sidecar://nnck/parse.

micronauts.name: quantum
micronauts.description: Quantum Trinity engine adapter — routes to one of: quantum_trinity (web research), quantum_personality, quantum_grammar, quantum_microagents (candidate-only sidecar), asx_ram_v2 (D3D11 xshard attention), asx_gemm. Sidecar: sidecar://quantum/dispatch with @engine arg.

micronauts.name: atomic_micronaut
micronauts.description: Atomic Micronaut v10 event-sourced orchestrator with Fisher-Rao trust decoding, deterministic routing, replay verification, and swarm coordination.

micronauts.name: think
micronauts.description: µ-think: Eliza-style scaffold thinker — classifies branch, inserts Think: header, posts to model. 9 branches: greeting/howto/explain/whyask/compare/command/reflect/debug/unknown. Template: programs/think.template.json. Brain: TM-1.

micronauts.name: ast
micronauts.description: µ-ast: deterministic grammar-to-KastNode parse and validation. Accepts source + grammar kind, emits KSON tree or structured error. Grammars: c/cpp/python/typescript/kuhul/kast/kson/scxq2. Brain: CM-1.

micronauts.name: tool
micronauts.description: µ-tool: tool selection and dispatch router. Validates intent against actions.manifest.json, builds tool_call JSON, dispatches via kuhul_task_boss (:8764). Requires Chen verification. Logs to tool_dispatch_proof.json. Brain: SM-1.

micronauts.name: reason
micronauts.description: µ-reason: multi-step explicit reasoning chain. Extracts premises, applies rules, derives conclusions via numbered steps, contradiction-checks with eliza (Chen), emits verdict. Brain: PM-1.

micronauts.name: expand
micronauts.description: µ-expand (XM-1 ExtrapolationMicronaut): narrative expansion, extrapolation, metaphor, synthesis, counterfactual. 6 expansion modes: extrapolate/hypothesize/synthesize/elaborate/metaphor/analogy. Highest birdsong confidence_prior (1.337). Brain: XM-1.

micronauts.name: semantic_cube
micronauts.description: 6-face semantic tensor (K-CUBE geometry) — SH projection selects dominant µ; faces: Phi/Fold/Gram/Geodesic/Projection/Entropy. Underpins all fold µ routing.

micronauts.name: alice
micronauts.description: ALICE AIML conversational agent — pure KXML dialogue rules corpus (mp0–mp6, ~7.3M tokens). ELIZA sub-project; owned by versions/alice-v1.0.0.

micronauts.name: regex
micronauts.description: Pattern matching µ — RegEx parsing for KXML token streams, schema validation, AIML pattern guards, and corpus filtering.

micronauts.name: adam
micronauts.description: Adam optimizer µ — gradient accumulation + parameter update kernel. kernel_class: adam_optimizer. Dispatched via SMCA/kxc pipeline.
